prompt: Build a one-page website for a neighborhood bakery called Rise & Shine, with the menu, hours, and location.
summary: A one-page static brochure site for a neighborhood bakery, presenting the menu, hours, and location. All content is fixed and read-only with no transactions or persisted user data, so a single static_site fully serves the prompt—no backend or database is warranted.

services.name: rise-and-shine-site
services.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp src/*.html src/*.css dist/ && cp assets/*.jpg dist/
